_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Kingdom of Sand#000.src: ... Until now. I believe I've managed to trace its possession to a nearby group of bandits. They probably have no idea what they're sitting on.
Kingdom of Sand#000.dst: …今までは。近くの盗賊団が持っていると突き止めたと思う。彼らは自分たちが何を持っているか分かっていないでしょうね。

Kingdom of Sand#001.src: Oi! Remember, yer need to nab that journal from the big mansion in {p}, if yer want to get in with us.
Kingdom of Sand#001.dst: おい！忘れんなよ、仲間になりてえなら {p} のでけえ屋敷から日誌をかっぱらってこい。

Kingdom of Sand#003.src: Looks like this is the room the journal is kept in...
Kingdom of Sand#003.dst: 日誌が保管されているのはこの部屋らしい…

Kingdom of Sand#004.src: What yer waiting for, get in here!
Kingdom of Sand#004.dst: 何ぐずぐずしてる、早く入れ！

Kingdom of Sand#005.src: Seems like there's a meeting going on...
Kingdom of Sand#005.dst: 会合が開かれているようだ…

Kingdom of Sand#006.src: Seems like that broken cart by the river might be worth checking out...
Kingdom of Sand#006.dst: 川辺の壊れた荷車を調べてみる価値がありそうだ…

Kingdom of Sand#008.src: Seems like that note might give you a clue...
Kingdom of Sand#008.dst: あのメモが手がかりになりそうだ…

Kingdom of Sand#009.src: The sceptre hums with unmeasurable power, filled with a thousand years of Desert history.
Kingdom of Sand#009.dst: 王笏は計り知れない力でうなりを上げている。砂漠の千年の歴史が詰まっているのだ。

Kingdom of Sand#010.src: You should get this back to Junes as soon as possible.
Kingdom of Sand#010.dst: できるだけ早くこれを Junes に届けよう。

Kingdom of Sand#012.src: I should get it to {p} right away. Thank you, {u}. You have my eternal gratitude.
Kingdom of Sand#012.dst: すぐに {p} へ届けなきゃ。ありがとう、{u}。このご恩は一生忘れないわ。

Kingdom of Sand#013.src: Are you thinking of exploring the tomb? I'm sure you could learn so much about the Empire... but you best be careful.
Kingdom of Sand#013.dst: 墓を探索するつもり？帝国について多くを学べるはずよ… でも気をつけてね。

Kingdom of Sand#014.src: I have little to offer you for your help, but please accept these emeralds, and this lesser treasure I found nearby.
Kingdom of Sand#014.dst: お礼にできることは少ないけど、このエメラルドと、近くで見つけたささやかなお宝を受け取って。

Kingdom of Sand#016.src: A {p} soldier! I imagine you're here to investigate the tomb up the hill?
Kingdom of Sand#016.dst: {p} の兵士ね！丘の上の墓を調べに来たのかしら？
Kingdom of Sand#016.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#017.src: It's believed to house the remains of Prince Hashr, the son of the old Desert Emperor, but it's far too dangerous for me to explore personally.
Kingdom of Sand#017.dst: 旧 Desert Emperor の息子、Prince Hashr の遺骸が眠るとされているけど、私が自分で調べるには危険すぎるの。
Kingdom of Sand#017.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#018.src: Instead I've been looking into a related legend - the Emperor's Sceptre.
Kingdom of Sand#018.dst: 代わりに関連する伝説を調べていたの――Emperor's Sceptre よ。
Kingdom of Sand#018.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#019.src: It was the source of his power, and potentially one of the most important artifacts in history.
Kingdom of Sand#019.dst: それは皇帝の力の源で、歴史上最も重要な遺物の一つかもしれないわ。
Kingdom of Sand#019.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#020.src: When the Emperor was slain by his son, Hashr, it is said that the sceptre was lost amongst the raging sandstorm that followed.
Kingdom of Sand#020.dst: 皇帝が息子 Hashr に殺された時、王笏はその後の猛烈な砂嵐の中で失われたと言われているの。
Kingdom of Sand#020.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#021.src: ... Until now. I believe I have been able to trace its possession to a nearby group of bandits. They probably have no idea what they're sitting on.
Kingdom of Sand#021.dst: …今までは。近くの盗賊団が持っていると突き止めたと思う。彼らは自分たちが何を持っているか分かっていないでしょうね。
Kingdom of Sand#021.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#022.src: I'm not prepared to confront them myself, but... this artifact belongs in a museum, in the hands of careful and respectful researchers.
Kingdom of Sand#022.dst: 自分で奴らに立ち向かう覚悟はないけど… この遺物は博物館に、慎重で敬意ある研究者の手にあるべきなの。
Kingdom of Sand#022.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#023.src: I would be in your debt if you could try to retrieve it, for the sake of history.
Kingdom of Sand#023.dst: 歴史のために取り戻してもらえたら、恩に着るわ。
Kingdom of Sand#023.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#024.src: Attempt to enter the bandit hideout at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Kingdom of Sand#024.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の盗賊のアジトに入ろうとする。

Kingdom of Sand#025.dst: なんだ、アジトに入りてえのか？
Kingdom of Sand#025.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#026.src: Even if yer a crooked soldier, we can't jus let yer in.
Kingdom of Sand#026.dst: おめえが悪徳兵士だろうと、ただで入れるわけにはいかねえ。
Kingdom of Sand#026.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#027.src: That is, unless yer got the password?
Kingdom of Sand#027.dst: もっとも、合言葉を知ってりゃ別だがな？
Kingdom of Sand#027.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#028.src: Didn’t think so. Now get lost, wasted enough of my t-
Kingdom of Sand#028.dst: だろうな。さっさと失せろ、もう十分時間を無駄に――
Kingdom of Sand#028.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#029.src: Now would you look at that... Even soldiers think they can waltz in ere.
Kingdom of Sand#029.dst: おやおや、見てみな… 兵士までここにのこのこ入れると思ってやがる。
Kingdom of Sand#029.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#030.src: Having fun thinking of a password? Sorry to spoil your lunch, but there isn’t one!
Kingdom of Sand#030.dst: 合言葉を考えるのは楽しいか？水を差して悪いが、そんなものはないぜ！
Kingdom of Sand#030.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#031.src: We could use a few more officials on the roster.
Kingdom of Sand#031.dst: 役人の仲間がもう少し欲しいところでな。
Kingdom of Sand#031.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#032.src: If yer are on the liberal side of the law, talk to us outside.
Kingdom of Sand#032.dst: 法のゆるい側にいるってんなら、外で話そうや。
Kingdom of Sand#032.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#033.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Geo と Tarek に会う。

Kingdom of Sand#034.src: Looks like yer in. Look, there ain't a password cause we're meant to be the best thieves in the land, right?
Kingdom of Sand#034.dst: 乗り気みてえだな。いいか、合言葉がねえのは、俺らがこの国一番の盗賊だからだ、だろ？
Kingdom of Sand#034.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#035.src: So what good are words? Yer gotta give the guard somethin' stolen, aintcha!
Kingdom of Sand#035.dst: 言葉なんか何の役に立つ？見張りには盗んだモンを渡すんだよ！
Kingdom of Sand#035.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#036.src: And we just so happen to have the opportunity of a lifetime for you. {p} has gone soft see, a new Mayor is cleaning things up.
Kingdom of Sand#036.dst: そして、ちょうどお前に一生に一度のチャンスがある。{p} は甘くなってな、新しい町長が掃除を始めてる。
Kingdom of Sand#036.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#037.src: Well, we can't have government not under our control. {p} will always be bandit capital.
Kingdom of Sand#037.dst: 政府を俺らの手から離すわけにゃいかねえ。{p} はいつだって盗賊の都だ。
Kingdom of Sand#037.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#038.src: So how about we give him a taste of his own medicine, and get hold of that journal he keeps? I'm sure that’ll dig up some dirt on him.
Kingdom of Sand#038.dst: そこで、奴に同じ目を見せてやろう。奴がつけてる日誌を手に入れるんだ。きっと弱みが出てくるぜ。
Kingdom of Sand#038.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#039.src: And by "we", we mean you. You'll have to sneak through the mansion and avoid guards.
Kingdom of Sand#039.dst: 「俺たち」ってのはおめえのことだ。屋敷に忍び込んで、見張りを避けな。
Kingdom of Sand#039.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#040.src: He keeps his journal in the highest room. Might need to distract some guards too. It's the biggest mansion in {p}, can't miss it.
Kingdom of Sand#040.dst: 日誌は一番高い部屋にある。見張りの気もそらす必要があるかもな。{p} で一番でけえ屋敷だ、見逃さねえよ。
Kingdom of Sand#040.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#041.src: Sneak into the highest room of the {p} Mansion at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Kingdom of Sand#041.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} Mansion の最上階の部屋に忍び込む。

Kingdom of Sand#042.src: Arh, there's the thief I saw a-sneakin' round the Mansion! Get them!
Kingdom of Sand#042.dst: おっ、屋敷の周りをこそこそしてた盗人だ！捕まえろ！
Kingdom of Sand#042.speaker: Mansion Guard

Kingdom of Sand#043.src: Yer know you could get kicked out of the army fer this.
Kingdom of Sand#043.dst: こんなことしたら軍をクビになるかもしれねえぜ。
Kingdom of Sand#043.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#044.src: Heh, guess yer the real thing. Hop in, lets get out of ‘ere.
Kingdom of Sand#044.dst: へっ、本物みてえだな。乗りな、ここからずらかるぞ。
Kingdom of Sand#044.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#045.src: That journal is more valuable than any gem, you'll be able to get in fer sure.
Kingdom of Sand#045.dst: その日誌はどんな宝石より価値がある。これで確実に入れるぜ。
Kingdom of Sand#045.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#046.src: Bring the journal from the {p} Mansion to the Vault Guard to enter the hideout.
Kingdom of Sand#046.dst: {p} Mansion の日誌を Vault Guard に渡し、アジトに入る。

Kingdom of Sand#049.src: Oh, this is quite the password, "soldier". I think this will do nicely, on you go.
Kingdom of Sand#049.dst: おお、こいつは大した合言葉だ、「兵士さん」。これなら十分だ、通りな。
Kingdom of Sand#049.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#050.src: Look for the sceptre within the bandit hideout at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Kingdom of Sand#050.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の盗賊のアジトで王笏を探す。

Kingdom of Sand#051.src: Right, then, you lot. Give me your reports.
Kingdom of Sand#051.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#052.src: Gold relieved from Mesa travellers last week counted just over {~} bars.
Kingdom of Sand#052.dst: 先週 Mesa の旅人から「頂いた」金は、数えたら {~} 本ちょっとでした。
Kingdom of Sand#052.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#054.src: We're working on exposing that blasted {p} Mayor with a stolen journal. {p} should be back under Creden Tibus control within the week.
Kingdom of Sand#054.dst: 盗んだ日誌で、あの忌々しい {p} の町長の化けの皮を剥がす作戦中です。一週間以内に {p} は Creden Tibus の支配下に戻ります。
Kingdom of Sand#054.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#056.src: Well... someone's been hanging around the old tomb. An archaeologist, looks like. I reckon she's lookin' for the sceptre.
Kingdom of Sand#056.dst: その… 古い墓の周りをうろついてる奴がいます。考古学者みたいで。王笏を探してるんじゃないかと。
Kingdom of Sand#056.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#057.src: Ah... that sceptre's too valuable for us to lose. Maybe we pay 'er a visit, persuade her to... stop lookin'.
Kingdom of Sand#057.dst: ああ… あの王笏は失うには惜しすぎる。そいつを訪ねて、探すのを… やめるよう説得するか。
Kingdom of Sand#057.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#058.src: Right you are, boss. Good thing no one will think to look for it in that broken cart by the river, ey?!
Kingdom of Sand#058.dst: その通りです、ボス。川辺の壊れた荷車の中を探そうなんて誰も思わないでしょうし、ね？！
Kingdom of Sand#058.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#059.src: Shut it, you fool! What did I just say? Anyway, I'll decide what to do with this archaeologist. Dismissed!
Kingdom of Sand#059.dst: 黙れ、馬鹿者！今何て言った？とにかく、考古学者の件は俺が決める。解散！
Kingdom of Sand#059.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#060.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の壊れた荷車を調べる。

Kingdom of Sand#061.dst: 誰かが聞き耳を立ててると思ってたぜ。
Kingdom of Sand#061.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#062.src: We might be bandits, but we’re not stupid. That sceptre is left better off alone.
Kingdom of Sand#062.dst: 俺たちは盗賊だが、馬鹿じゃねえ。あの王笏は放っておくのが一番だ。
Kingdom of Sand#062.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#065.src: Return to the tomb and give Junes the sceptre at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Kingdom of Sand#065.dst: 墓に戻り、[{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Junes に王笏を渡す。

Kingdom of Sand#066.src: Ah, {u}. I couldn't help myself - I simply had to see the tomb up close.
Kingdom of Sand#066.dst: あら、{u}。我慢できなくて――どうしても墓を間近で見たかったの。
Kingdom of Sand#066.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#067.src: You have no idea how tempted I am to go inside, but I doubt I'd make it out alive.
Kingdom of Sand#067.dst: 中に入りたくてたまらないけど、生きて出られるとは思えないわ。
Kingdom of Sand#067.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#068.src: You... you found the sceptre? Oh! This is incredible! I can't believe it!
Kingdom of Sand#068.dst: あなた… 王笏を見つけたの？まあ！信じられない！すごいわ！
Kingdom of Sand#068.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#069.src: This artifact, it witnessed the rise and fall of the Empire, thousands of years ago. And you've just been... holding it, without gloves...
Kingdom of Sand#069.dst: この遺物は、数千年前の帝国の興亡を見届けてきたの。それをあなたは… 手袋もなしに持ってたのね…
Kingdom of Sand#069.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#070.src: Under the circumstances, I think I can let that slide. But the things I could learn from studying it...
Kingdom of Sand#070.dst: 状況が状況だし、見逃してあげる。でも、これを研究すれば分かることといったら…
Kingdom of Sand#070.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#071.src: I should get to {p} right away. Thank you, {u}. You have my eternal gratitude.
Kingdom of Sand#071.dst: すぐに {p} へ向かわなきゃ。ありがとう、{u}。このご恩は一生忘れないわ。
Kingdom of Sand#071.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#072.src: Are you thinking of exploring the tomb? I'm sure you can learn so much about the Empire... but you best be careful.
Kingdom of Sand#072.dst: 墓を探索するつもり？帝国について多くを学べるはずよ… でも気をつけてね。
Kingdom of Sand#072.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#073.src: There are nasty legends of what it holds. Silverfish, skeletons... even Prince Hashr himself. Make sure to gear up!
Kingdom of Sand#073.dst: 中には恐ろしい伝説があるの。シルバーフィッシュ、骸骨… Prince Hashr 本人まで。装備は万全にね！
Kingdom of Sand#073.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#074.src: I have little to offer you for your help, but please accept these emeralds, and a fossil bone I found around here.
Kingdom of Sand#074.dst: お礼にできることは少ないけど、このエメラルドと、この辺りで見つけた化石の骨を受け取って。
Kingdom of Sand#074.speaker: Junes
